project.name: Rune DSL Optimised IR-routed Java Generation
project.description: The v3 OPTIMISED Java backend over the shared IR (route 3 of the one-IR/three-backends architecture — the phase plan the development plan "2026-08-10-p3-optimised-codegen-phase-plan" § 2; PR-3 lands the skeleton). Registers the rune-java-generator OptimisedIRGenerationProvider service under its OWN service file — the route activates only behind -Drosetta.generator.ir.optimised=true with this jar on the classpath; flag-off is byte-identical by construction on both standing routes, and the skeleton provider DECLINES every seam (Path-1 fallback) until emission families land (PR-4+). Consumes rune-ir READ-ONLY; zero code-path sharing with the reference backend (rune-ir-java) beyond the shared SPI types. OUTSIDE the release six until the phase ships.
